content.text:
The bug was in `rb_push` in `src/ringbuf.c`. It wrote to `data[len % cap]` and ignored `head`, so once the buffer had wrapped, new values landed in the wrong slot. I changed the index to `(head + len) % cap`.

`make test` now reports 118 checks, 0 failures. All 28 failures before the fix were in the ringbuf wrap tests. I didn't touch anything under `tests/`.
